verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's own materials say Ari proactively 'messages you when something moves rather than waiting to be asked' and 'tells you what changed before you ask.' The pricing page also lists 'Proactive alerts & triggers.' That covers the metric-movement half of the story, but only as marketing-level claims; nothing shows alerts are tied to variance against plan, or that any reminder fires before a reporting deadline. Missing for 10: documented plan-vs-actual variance alert configuration, reporting-deadline reminders, detail on delivery channels and thresholds, independent or hands-on corroboration.
